title: Australian Midnight Meringue Custard Bars (Keto)
description: A low-carb twist on the classic Australian dessert, featuring a crunchy meringue crust and a rich custard filling. Perfect for keto dieters looking for a decadent treat.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together almond flour, granulated sweetener, and unsalted butter until well combined.
Press mixture into the bottom of a parchment-lined baking dish.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until lightly golden.
In a separate bowl, whisk together egg yolks and heavy cream until smooth.
Stir in granulated sweetener and vanilla extract.
Pour custard mixture over baked meringue crust.
Return to oven and bake for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until set.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
